title: At the barrow's throne room, choosing 'weigh what each choice would mean' before deciding, or the gray priest's blessing, could become moot: after using the hunter's secret gap to enter the barrow (bypassing the sealed doors), returning to the priest for 'a blessing for the barrow' produced a dead-end line ('the doors are already open... say the words yourself') with no mechanical effect, even though the reeve/priest door-sealing questline implied the blessing mattered. Minor narrative dead branch, not blocking.
where: Gray Chapel / priest 'a blessing for the barrow'
